title: solprop: ultrafast nonlinear pulse propagation
description: solprop simulates ultrafast nonlinear optical pulse propagation with the unidirectional pulse propagation equation and the generalised nonlinear Schrödinger equation, for field and envelope, in single-mode, multimode and general modal waveguides and in radial, Cartesian, planar and line free-space geometries, with Kerr, Raman, plasma and ionisation responses.
